lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {α β ε : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 < α →
        0 < β →
          0 < ε →
            (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
              ∀ {xstar : E},
                IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar →
                  ∀ (x₀ : E) (N : ℕ),
                    (0 < ‖x₀ - xstar‖ → 2 * (β / α) * Real.log (‖x₀ - xstar‖ / ε) ≤ ↑N) →
                      ‖(fun x => x - β⁻¹ • gradient f x)^[N] x₀ - xstar‖ ≤ ε
approved_definition_context: ContDiff R 1 f means continuously Frechet differentiable. gradient f x is the Riesz representative of its Frechet derivative.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ alpha f means f((1-t)x+t y)<=(1-t)f(x)+t f(y)-(alpha/2)t(1-t)||x-y||² for x,y in E and t in [0,1].
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for all x. Function.iterate T N applies T exactly N times, and zero iterations is the identity.
Real.log is the real natural logarithm, totalized in Lean with log0=0; on positive arguments it is the usual inverse of exp. Norm and inner product use the stated Hilbert space.
